name: SIQ - Morphing Panels
description: Luxurious accordion-to-slider with expanding panels that morph smoothly between collapsed and full-width states. Each panel features full-bleed imagery with editorial content overlays. Warm cream and gold palette with staggered reveal animations, autoplay, keyboard navigation, and elegant hover expansions. Ideal for portfolios, case studies, and brand storytelling.
